key: CAIN: This is the old Yureyu building that was destroyed in the earthquakes...
en: CAIN: This is the old Yureyu building that was destroyed in the earthquakes...
ja: カイン: ここが、地震で崩れた旧ユーレユビルか……

key: Haha, it's kinda creepy, huh?
en: Haha, it's kinda creepy, huh?
ja: はは、なんか不気味だな?

key: Could they really be in here?
en: Could they really be in here?
ja: 本当にここにいるのか?

key: CAIN: Hey, \PN, I'm gonna follow your lead here.
en: CAIN: Hey, \PN, I'm gonna follow your lead here.
ja: カイン: なあ、\PN、ここはお前についていくよ。

key: Never really done the whole "team up" thing before, so...
en: Never really done the whole "team up" thing before, so...
ja: 「タッグを組む」ってやつ、ちゃんとやったことないから……

key: S-so be gentle, s-senpai; it's my first time!
en: S-so be gentle, s-senpai; it's my first time!
ja: や、優しくしてくれよ、せ、先輩……はじめてなんだから!

key: CAIN: Heyyyyy, ready to go?
en: CAIN: Heyyyyy, ready to go?
ja: カイン: おーい、準備できたか?

key: I think we've kept them waiting long enough as is.
en: I think we've kept them waiting long enough as is.
ja: もう十分待たせたと思うぜ。

key: CAIN: Heyy, are you really gonna take off at a time like this?
en: CAIN: Heyy, are you really gonna take off at a time like this?
ja: カイン: おいおい、こんな時に本当に行っちまうのか?

key: I'll just hang here, I guess.
en: I'll just hang here, I guess.
ja: オレはここで待ってるよ。

key: 3F GATE OPEN
en: 3F GATE OPEN
ja: 3F ゲート開放

key: 5F GATE OPEN
en: 5F GATE OPEN
ja: 5F ゲート開放

key: GRUNT: That girl is good...
en: GRUNT: That girl is good...
ja: メテオ団員: あの子、なかなかやるな……

key: You sure she doesn't wanna work for us?
en: You sure she doesn't wanna work for us?
ja: こっちで働く気、本当にないのかね?

key: GRUNT: Oh well! I'm sure the boss already has what he needs!
en: GRUNT: Oh well! I'm sure the boss already has what he needs!
ja: メテオ団員: まあいいさ! ボスはもう必要なものを手に入れてるだろうしな!

key: TARA: The day when Team Meteor rebuilds is coming closer and closer~
en: TARA: The day when Team Meteor rebuilds is coming closer and closer~
ja: タラ: チームメテオが再興する日が、どんどん近づいてくるね~

key: Even if we lose now, it won't matter!
en: Even if we lose now, it won't matter!
ja: 今負けたって、関係ないの!

key: Soon, the world can be transformed into a true paradise!
en: Soon, the world can be transformed into a true paradise!
ja: もうすぐ、世界は本当の楽園に生まれ変わるんだから!

key: SIMON: We're not evil.
en: SIMON: We're not evil.
ja: サイモン: 俺たちは悪じゃない。

key: We're trying to fix things.
en: We're trying to fix things.
ja: ただ、物事を正そうとしているだけだ。

key: Although people may be hurt, or even die, when we recreate the world, their suffering will be erased.
en: Although people may be hurt, or even die, when we recreate the world, their suffering will be erased.
ja: 世界を作り直す過程で、人が傷つき、命を落とすことがあっても、その苦しみは消し去られる。

key: Perhaps, even those that have been wronged can be restored to life...
en: Perhaps, even those that have been wronged can be restored to life...
ja: もしかしたら、不当な目に遭った者たちさえ、生き返らせることができるかもしれない……

key: HEATHER: ...
en: HEATHER: ...
ja: ヘザー: ……

key: SIGMUND: And so you're here again.
en: SIGMUND: And so you're here again.
ja: シグムンド: また、来ましたか。

key: SIGMUND: So, you've come again.
en: SIGMUND: So, you've come again.
ja: シグムンド: また来たのですね。

key: SIGMUND: I confess it was fortunate that Sirius of this "Team Meteor" came to me with the proposal that he did.
en: SIGMUND: I confess it was fortunate that Sirius of this "Team Meteor" came to me with the proposal that he did.
ja: シグムンド: 正直に言えば、この「チームメテオ」のシリウスが、あの提案を持ちかけてきたのは幸運でした。

key: He had the means to capture my fugitives, and for payment he needed only to extract from this girl a single object--
en: He had the means to capture my fugitives, and for payment he needed only to extract from this girl a single object--
ja: 彼には、逃げた子どもたちを捕らえる手段があり、その報酬として求めたのは、この少女からある物ひとつを引き出すことだけでした――

key: A Ruby Ring.
en: A Ruby Ring.
ja: ルビーのゆびわです。

key: CAIN: If it's just the ring you want, what are you even doing, keeping her up here?
en: CAIN: If it's just the ring you want, what are you even doing, keeping her up here?
ja: カイン: 指輪だけが目的なら、なんで彼女をここに閉じ込めてるんだよ?

key: SIGMUND: I ask myself the same.
en: SIGMUND: I ask myself the same.
ja: シグムンド: 私自身にも、同じ問いをしています。

key: Treatment has not been called for, if that is your concern.
en: Treatment has not been called for, if that is your concern.
ja: ご心配なら言っておきますが、治療の必要はありません。

key: At Sirius' behest, I was to detain and question her.
en: At Sirius' behest, I was to detain and question her.
ja: シリウスの依頼で、彼女を拘束し、尋問することになっていました。

key: But that is demonstratedly fruitless, given that she has become withdrawn to the point of silence...
en: But that is demonstratedly fruitless, given that she has become withdrawn to the point of silence...
ja: しかし、彼女がここまで無言になってしまった以上、それが実を結ばないのは明白です……

key: CAIN: And whose fault do you think that is?
en: CAIN: And whose fault do you think that is?
ja: カイン: それ、誰のせいだと思ってるんだ?

key: After what you did to her, she may not even be able to speak at all!
en: After what you did to her, she may not even be able to speak at all!
ja: あんたが彼女にしたことのせいで、もう口すらきけないかもしれないんだぞ!

key: SIGMUND: Loss of speech is not among the effects of electroconvulsive therapy.
en: SIGMUND: Loss of speech is not among the effects of electroconvulsive therapy.
ja: シグムンド: 発話能力の喪失は、電気けいれん療法の副作用には含まれません。

key: Trust me to know my trade.
en: Trust me to know my trade.
ja: 私の専門分野くらい、信頼していただきたいものです。

key: She has most certainly not lost her ability to speak.
en: She has most certainly not lost her ability to speak.
ja: 彼女は間違いなく、話す能力を失ってはいません。

key: Only her will.
en: Only her will.
ja: 失ったのは、意志だけです。

key: And yet, you appear to have constructed a certain image of me in your mind already.
en: And yet, you appear to have constructed a certain image of me in your mind already.
ja: それでも、あなたはすでに私について、ある種の像を作り上げているようですね。

key: Do you intend to fight me regardless of what I say?
en: Do you intend to fight me regardless of what I say?
ja: 私が何を言おうと、戦うおつもりですか?

key: SIGMUND: Just as well.
en: SIGMUND: Just as well.
ja: シグムンド: それも結構。

key: Then I won't stop you from proceeding onwards.
en: Then I won't stop you from proceeding onwards.
ja: でしたら、先へ進むのは止めません。

key: SIGMUND: I may have invested myself in this "Team Meteor", but I have no regard for their malevolent actions.
en: SIGMUND: I may have invested myself in this "Team Meteor", but I have no regard for their malevolent actions.
ja: シグムンド: この「チームメテオ」に関わってはいますが、彼らの悪意ある行動に共感しているわけではありません。

key: Yet, I am bound to their service for a different reason entirely--
en: Yet, I am bound to their service for a different reason entirely--
ja: それでも、私が彼らに従っているのは、まったく別の理由からです――

key: Strictly a matter of my personal curiosity.
en: Strictly a matter of my personal curiosity.
ja: ひとえに、私自身の個人的な好奇心の問題です。

key: There's a name I hear thrown about among their officers.
en: There's a name I hear thrown about among their officers.
ja: 彼らの幹部の間で、ある名前が飛び交うのを耳にしました。

key: It's a name I used to know, but it cannot possibly be...
en: It's a name I used to know, but it cannot possibly be...
ja: かつて私が知っていた名前ですが、まさかそんなはずは……

key: Ahem.
en: Ahem.
ja: コホン

key: Pardon, I was speaking too much.
en: Pardon, I was speaking too much.
ja: 失礼、話しすぎました。

key: This time only, I will turn away.
en: This time only, I will turn away.
ja: 今回だけは、見て見ぬふりをしましょう。

key: When you flee, I will not stop this girl from joining you.
en: When you flee, I will not stop this girl from joining you.
ja: あなた方が逃げる時、この少女があなた方に加わるのを、私は止めません。

key: This is hardly a therapeutic environment anyway...
en: This is hardly a therapeutic environment anyway...
ja: どのみち、ここは治療環境と呼べる場所ではありませんから……

key: SIGMUND: So be it.
en: SIGMUND: So be it.
ja: シグムンド: それでいいでしょう。

key: Hrm...
en: Hrm...
ja: ふむ……

key: I'm sure this will be settled in short order nevertheless.
en: I'm sure this will be settled in short order nevertheless.
ja: それでも、これはすぐに片がつくはずです。

key: CAIN: Heather, are you okay?
en: CAIN: Heather, are you okay?
ja: カイン: ヘザー、大丈夫か?

key: CAIN: Bleh. Still nothing, huh?
en: CAIN: Bleh. Still nothing, huh?
ja: カイン: うへえ。まだ何も、か?

key: What's wrong...?
en: What's wrong...?
ja: どうしたんだよ……?

key: SIGMUND: I haven't the mind to humor a battle currently.
en: SIGMUND: I haven't the mind to humor a battle currently.
ja: シグムンド: 今は、バトルに付き合う気分ではありません。

key: There is much I must consider instead...
en: There is much I must consider instead...
ja: 代わりに、考えなければならないことが多くありますので……

key: Do not expect the same favor in the future.
en: Do not expect the same favor in the future.
ja: 今後も同じ配慮を期待しないことです。

key: SIRIUS: Is that so, Doctor?
en: SIRIUS: Is that so, Doctor?
ja: シリウス: そうか、ドクター?

key: ANNA: \PN! Cain!
en: ANNA: \PN! Cain!
ja: アンナ: \PN! カイン!

key: CAIN: Heyy, we finally made it!
en: CAIN: Heyy, we finally made it!
ja: カイン: おーい、やっと着いたぞ!

key: SIRIUS: So you failed to defend your patients, and now you expect me to bail you out?
en: SIRIUS: So you failed to defend your patients, and now you expect me to bail you out?
ja: シリウス: 患者を守り切れなかった挙句、私に尻拭いをさせようというのか?

key: SIGMUND: I was simply informing you...
en: SIGMUND: I was simply informing you...
ja: シグムンド: ただ報告していただけです……

key: SIRIUS: Doctor, it was your goal to keep the children captive-- not mine.
en: SIRIUS: Doctor, it was your goal to keep the children captive-- not mine.
ja: シリウス: ドクター、子どもたちを捕らえておくのは、あなたの目的だ――私のではない。

key: All I sought was to obtain a certain artifact.
en: All I sought was to obtain a certain artifact.
ja: 私が求めていたのは、ある品物ひとつだけだ。

key: SIGMUND: You were the one who insisted they be kept for--
en: SIGMUND: You were the one who insisted they be kept for--
ja: シグムンド: 彼らを留め置くよう主張したのは、あなたの――

key: SIRIUS: Of course, I hadn't expected to find two of them.
en: SIRIUS: Of course, I hadn't expected to find two of them.
ja: シリウス: もっとも、二つとも見つかるとは思っていなかったがな。

key: SIRIUS: Did no one teach you to knock before entering?
en: SIRIUS: Did no one teach you to knock before entering?
ja: シリウス: 入る前にノックすることを、誰も教えなかったのか?

key: This is my private office.
en: This is my private office.
ja: ここは私の私室だ。

key: I would appreciate due courtesy.
en: I would appreciate due courtesy.
ja: 相応の礼儀を求めたいものだな。

key: Did the Doctor falter already?
en: Did the Doctor falter already?
ja: ドクターはもうひるんだのか?

key: I heard no commotion downstairs.
en: I heard no commotion downstairs.
ja: 下で騒ぎが聞こえなかったが。

key: CAIN: He didn't even try.
en: CAIN: He didn't even try.
ja: カイン: 抵抗すらしなかったぜ。

key: SIRIUS: Senile old man.
en: SIRIUS: Senile old man.
ja: シリウス: ボケた老人め。

key: He was the one who wanted to detain the children.
en: He was the one who wanted to detain the children.
ja: 子どもたちを拘束したがっていたのは、あの男の方だ。

key: I thought we might have had a useful partnership,
en: I thought we might have had a useful partnership,
ja: 有益な協力関係になると思っていたのだが、

key: But he drivels on and on about 'stress response' this and 'traumatic event' that...
en: But he drivels on and on about 'stress response' this and 'traumatic event' that...
ja: あの男ときたら「ストレス反応」だの「トラウマ的出来事」だの、延々とたわ言を並べる……

key: At least he was good for his employees.
en: At least he was good for his employees.
ja: まあ、雇い人としては役に立っていたがな。

key: That, and...
en: That, and...
ja: それに……

key: It's strange, isn't it?
en: It's strange, isn't it?
ja: 不思議なものだな。

key: We needed only ensnare Ruby, and we caught Amethyst, too.
en: We needed only ensnare Ruby, and we caught Amethyst, too.
ja: ルビーを捕らえるだけでよかったのに、アメジストまで手に入った。

key: ANNA: Give me back my pendant!
en: ANNA: Give me back my pendant!
ja: アンナ: あたしのペンダント、返して!

key: It's-- It's the only thing I have left of my father...
en: It's-- It's the only thing I have left of my father...
ja: それ――それだけが、お父さんの残した唯一のものなの……

key: SIRIUS: Your father?
en: SIRIUS: Your father?
ja: シリウス: お前の父親?

key: Ah.
en: Ah.
ja: ああ。

key: I suppose I can see the resemblance.
en: I suppose I can see the resemblance.
ja: 面影があるようだな。

key: ANNA: You knew my dad?!
en: ANNA: You knew my dad?!
ja: アンナ: あたしのお父さんを知ってるの?!

key: SIRIUS: He was a fool.
en: SIRIUS: He was a fool.
ja: シリウス: あの男は愚か者だった。

key: The unrefined, short-sighted type.
en: The unrefined, short-sighted type.
ja: 粗野で、目先しか見えない類のな。

key: The type that history tries too hard to forget.
en: The type that history tries too hard to forget.
ja: 歴史が、必死に忘れようとする類の男だ。

key: ANNA: Don't say things like that!
en: ANNA: Don't say things like that!
ja: アンナ: そんなこと言わないで!

key: SIRIUS: Ah, but it is so true.
en: SIRIUS: Ah, but it is so true.
ja: シリウス: ああ、だが真実だ。

key: The gems of your ever-so-precious pendant that he gave you--
en: The gems of your ever-so-precious pendant that he gave you--
ja: あの男がお前に与えた、そのご大層なペンダントの宝石は――

key: They were not always the brilliant, polished crystal you know.
en: They were not always the brilliant, polished crystal you know.
ja: 最初から、お前の知るような輝く磨かれた結晶だったわけではない。

key: Stones must be cut to be shaped.
en: Stones must be cut to be shaped.
ja: 石は、削られて初めて形を得る。

key: People are the same.
en: People are the same.
ja: 人間も同じだ。

key: Sometimes the stone breaks if you make the wrong cut.
en: Sometimes the stone breaks if you make the wrong cut.
ja: 切り方を誤れば、石は砕けることもある。

key: And your father, the miserable, treacherous lout that he was...
en: And your father, the miserable, treacherous lout that he was...
ja: そして、お前の父親という、あの惨めで裏切り者の粗野な男は……

key: Well, he was very broken indeed.
en: Well, he was very broken indeed.
ja: まさに、見事なまでに砕けていたよ。

key: CAIN: Heyy buddy, I think you should stop talking and give the girl back her stuff.
en: CAIN: Heyy buddy, I think you should stop talking and give the girl back her stuff.
ja: カイン: おいおい、しゃべるのやめて、その子のもの返してやったらどうだ?

key: SIRIUS: Is that what you think I should do?
en: SIRIUS: Is that what you think I should do?
ja: シリウス: それが私のすべきことだと?

key: This conflict is as pointless as it is annoying.
en: This conflict is as pointless as it is annoying.
ja: この対立は、うんざりするほど無意味だな。

key: SIRIUS: "Her" stuff.
en: SIRIUS: "Her" stuff.
ja: シリウス: 「彼女の」もの、か。

key: It was ours before she was ever born.
en: It was ours before she was ever born.
ja: それは、彼女が生まれる前から我々のものだった。

key: This Amethyst Pendant and the Ruby Ring both.
en: This Amethyst Pendant and the Ruby Ring both.
ja: このアメジストのペンダントも、ルビーのゆびわも。

key: You don't have so much as an inkling of their true worth.
en: You don't have so much as an inkling of their true worth.
ja: お前たちは、その真の価値の欠片すら理解していない。

key: I will NOT relinquish such items for mere sentimentalities.
en: I will NOT relinquish such items for mere sentimentalities.
ja: ただの感傷ごときで、これらを手放すつもりはない。

key: CAIN: Then we'll just have to make you!
en: CAIN: Then we'll just have to make you!
ja: カイン: だったら、力ずくでやらせてもらうぜ!

key: Let's go, \PN!
en: Let's go, \PN!
ja: 行くぞ、\PN!

key: Insolent. You have no clue what you're fighting for or against.
en: Insolent. You have no clue what you're fighting for or against.
ja: 無礼な。貴様は　何のために　何と戦っているかすら　分かっていない

key: SIRIUS: Enough!
en: SIRIUS: Enough!
ja: シリウス: もういい!

key: This conflict is as pointless as it is infuriating!
en: This conflict is as pointless as it is infuriating!
ja: この対立は、腹立たしいほど無意味だ!

key: Do not presume to be in control of the situation after such a trifling victory.
en: Do not presume to be in control of the situation after such a trifling victory.
ja: そんなつまらない勝利ひとつで、状況を掌握したつもりになるな。

key: After all...
en: After all...
ja: なにしろ……

key: ANNA: Ow--
en: ANNA: Ow--
ja: アンナ: いたっ――

key: SIRIUS: Need I say more?
en: SIRIUS: Need I say more?
ja: シリウス: これ以上、言う必要があるか?

key: SIGMUND: Sirius, I cannot abide by this.
en: SIGMUND: Sirius, I cannot abide by this.
ja: シグムンド: シリウス、これは看過できません。

key: SIRIUS: Nor can you stop it.
en: SIRIUS: Nor can you stop it.
ja: シリウス: だが、止めることもできまい。

key: ANNA: Cain...?
en: ANNA: Cain...?
ja: アンナ: カイン……?

key: CAIN: Hey-- Hey, no--
en: CAIN: Hey-- Hey, no--
ja: カイン: おい――おい、やめろ――

key: Nobody wants this to happen, right?
en: Nobody wants this to happen, right?
ja: 誰もこんなこと望んでないだろ?

key: We can work this out, right?
en: We can work this out, right?
ja: 話し合いで解決できるだろ?

key: SIRIUS: I wonder.
en: SIRIUS: I wonder.
ja: シリウス: さあ、どうだろうな。

key: CAIN: Wait-- I know.
en: CAIN: Wait-- I know.
ja: カイン: 待てよ――そうだ。

key: Look, you lost a shipment, right?
en: Look, you lost a shipment, right?
ja: なあ、荷物をなくしただろ?

key: I picked this up-- it was supposed to reach you.
en: I picked this up-- it was supposed to reach you.
ja: これ、オレが拾ったんだ――あんたに届くはずだったやつだろ。

key: This, uhhh, green crystal thing?
en: This, uhhh, green crystal thing?
ja: この、ええと、緑の結晶みたいなやつ?

key: SIRIUS: ...You have the Emerald Brooch.
en: SIRIUS: ...You have the Emerald Brooch.
ja: シリウス: ……エメラルドのブローチを持っているのか。

key: And here I thought that old zealot's daughter still had it.
en: And here I thought that old zealot's daughter still had it.
ja: あの狂信者の娘が、まだ持っていると思っていたが。

key: It seems this truly is history in the making.
en: It seems this truly is history in the making.
ja: どうやら、本当に歴史が作られつつあるようだ。

key: The Brooch for her life, then.
en: The Brooch for her life, then.
ja: なら、ブローチと彼女の命を交換だ。

key: CAIN: Sure, whatever, yeah...
en: CAIN: Sure, whatever, yeah...
ja: カイン: ああ、なんでも、いいから……

key: SIRIUS: Give it here, boy, and slowly-- no sudden movements.
en: SIRIUS: Give it here, boy, and slowly-- no sudden movements.
ja: シリウス: よこせ、坊主。ゆっくりとだ――急な動きはするな。

key: Cain handed over the Emerald Brooch!
en: Cain handed over the Emerald Brooch!
ja: カインはエメラルドのブローチを手渡した!

key: SIRIUS: Go.
en: SIRIUS: Go.
ja: シリウス: 行け。

key: ANNA: U-um...
en: ANNA: U-um...
ja: アンナ: え、えっと……

key: Hey, uh, Nostra says we need to leave here right away...
en: Hey, uh, Nostra says we need to leave here right away...
ja: ねえ、その、ノストラが、今すぐここを出ないとって言ってる……

key: CAIN: You don't have to tell me twice.
en: CAIN: You don't have to tell me twice.
ja: カイン: 二度言われる必要もないぜ。

key: Let's skedaddle!
en: Let's skedaddle!
ja: とっとと逃げよう!

key: SIRIUS: To have three of the four already...
en: SIRIUS: To have three of the four already...
ja: シリウス: 四つのうち、すでに三つを手にしたか……

key: How marvelous.
en: How marvelous.
ja: なんとも見事なことだ。

key: SIGMUND: Sirius, I have some... concerns.
en: SIGMUND: Sirius, I have some... concerns.
ja: シグムンド: シリウス、少々……懸念があります。

key: SIRIUS: Not now, Doctor.
en: SIRIUS: Not now, Doctor.
ja: シリウス: 今はやめておけ、ドクター。

key: You've been useless enough already.
en: You've been useless enough already.
ja: お前はもう十分役立たずだ。

key: Are you determined to make yourself a detriment?
en: Are you determined to make yourself a detriment?
ja: それとも、自ら足手まといになろうというのか?

key: SIGMUND: I...
en: SIGMUND: I...
ja: シグムンド: 私は……

key: SIRIUS: Leave me.
en: SIRIUS: Leave me.
ja: シリウス: 下がれ。

key: SIRIUS: ...No, hold on.
en: SIRIUS: ...No, hold on.
ja: シリウス: ……いや、待て。

key: Something is not right here.
en: Something is not right here.
ja: 何かがおかしい。

key: The luster is not quite...
en: The luster is not quite...
ja: この光沢は、どうも……

key: SIRIUS: This isn't the Brooch.
en: SIRIUS: This isn't the Brooch.
ja: シリウス: これはブローチではないな。

key: Have I been tricked?
en: Have I been tricked?
ja: だまされたのか?

key: No, this isn't a crystal at all-- it would not cut like this.
en: No, this isn't a crystal at all-- it would not cut like this.
ja: いや、これは結晶ですらない――こんな切れ方はしない。

key: But I have seen this before, this...
en: But I have seen this before, this...
ja: だが、これは以前に見たことがある、この……

key: No, this is--
en: No, this is--
ja: いや、これは――

key: Verdignite!
en: Verdignite!
ja: ヴァーディグナイトだ!

key: SHELLY: What was that explosion?!
en: SHELLY: What was that explosion?!
ja: シェリー: 今の爆発、何?!

key: CAIN: No idea, just keep running!
en: CAIN: No idea, just keep running!
ja: カイン: わかんねえ、とにかく走れ!

key: NOEL: Anna, are you okay?
en: NOEL: Anna, are you okay?
ja: ノエル: アンナ、大丈夫か?

key: ANNA: I'm-- fine! Nothing's wrong!
en: ANNA: I'm-- fine! Nothing's wrong!
ja: アンナ: だ、大丈夫! 何ともない!

key: CHARLOTTE: Heather, keep up!
en: CHARLOTTE: Heather, keep up!
ja: シャルロット: ヘザー、遅れないで!

key: We're almost out of here!
en: We're almost out of here!
ja: もうすぐここから出られるから!

key: CAIN: Shelly!
en: CAIN: Shelly!
ja: カイン: シェリー!

key: GRUNT: Now, don't take another step closer or we'll cut her throat.
en: GRUNT: Now, don't take another step closer or we'll cut her throat.
ja: メテオ団員: それ以上近づくな、じゃないとこいつの喉をかっ切るぞ。

key: SHELLY: \PN...
en: SHELLY: \PN...
ja: シェリー: \PN……

key: C-Cain...
en: C-Cain...
ja: カ、カイン……

key: GRUNT: Just keep moving, and we'll pretend we didn't see anything. Got it?
en: GRUNT: Just keep moving, and we'll pretend we didn't see anything. Got it?
ja: メテオ団員: そのまま進め、そうすりゃ何も見なかったことにしてやる。わかったか?

key: SHELLY: I'm scared...
en: SHELLY: I'm scared...
ja: シェリー: 怖い……

key: CAIN: They said you wouldn't hurt her!
en: CAIN: They said you wouldn't hurt her!
ja: カイン: 彼女には手を出さないって言ったよな!

key: GRUNT: Not if you don't interfere.
en: GRUNT: Not if you don't interfere.
ja: メテオ団員: お前らが邪魔しなければな。

key: CAIN: Hey, now...
en: CAIN: Hey, now...
ja: カイン: おい、待てよ……

key: SHELLY: I-it's okay...
en: SHELLY: I-it's okay...
ja: シェリー: だ、大丈夫……

key: J-just... go on...
en: J-just... go on...
ja: い、行って……

key: It doesn't matter what happens t-to me...
en: It doesn't matter what happens t-to me...
ja: 私に何が起きても……関係ないから……

key: Find th-the others... okay...?
en: Find th-the others... okay...?
ja: み、みんなを見つけて……いいから……?

key: CAIN: Ugh...
en: CAIN: Ugh...
ja: カイン: くそ……

key: I'm sorry, Shelly.
en: I'm sorry, Shelly.
ja: ごめんな、シェリー。

key: We'll come back for you! I promise!
en: We'll come back for you! I promise!
ja: 必ず助けに戻る! 約束だ!

key: GRUNT: Hey! Back off unless you want her to get hurt.
en: GRUNT: Hey! Back off unless you want her to get hurt.
ja: メテオ団員: おい! こいつを傷つけたくなきゃ下がれ。

key: CAIN: Charlotte!
en: CAIN: Charlotte!
ja: カイン: シャルロット!

key: CHARLOTTE: It's about time you showed up, Princess.
en: CHARLOTTE: It's about time you showed up, Princess.
ja: シャルロット: やっと来たね、お姫様。

key: CAIN: We came as soon as we could!
en: CAIN: We came as soon as we could!
ja: カイン: できる限り急いで来たんだよ!

key: ...Not in the usual way.
en: ...Not in the usual way.
ja: ……いつもの手段じゃなかったけどな。

key: GRUNT: Back away or we'll kill her!
en: GRUNT: Back away or we'll kill her!
ja: メテオ団員: 下がれ、じゃなきゃこいつを殺すぞ!

key: CHARLOTTE: Really, guys?
en: CHARLOTTE: Really, guys?
ja: シャルロット: 本気で言ってる?

key: You're still on that?
en: You're still on that?
ja: まだそれ続けるつもり?

key: GRUNT: Well, uh, you know,
en: GRUNT: Well, uh, you know,
ja: メテオ団員: いや、その、まあ、

key: It's what the boss said to say, so...
en: It's what the boss said to say, so...
ja: ボスにそう言えって言われてるからさ……

key: CHARLOTTE: Sirius, right?
en: CHARLOTTE: Sirius, right?
ja: シャルロット: シリウス、でしょ?

key: Whatever, just forget it for now.
en: Whatever, just forget it for now.
ja: まあいいや、今はもう忘れよう。

key: Come on, meet my friends.
en: Come on, meet my friends.
ja: ほら、あたしの友達に会って。

key: This is \PN, and this is Princess.
en: This is \PN, and this is Princess.
ja: こっちが\PNで、こっちがお姫様。

key: \PN, Princess, meet Simon and Tara.
en: \PN, Princess, meet Simon and Tara.
ja: \PN、お姫様、サイモンとタラだよ。

key: SIMON: We've met.
en: SIMON: We've met.
ja: サイモン: もう会ってる。

key: TARA: Yeah, \PN beat us before.
en: TARA: Yeah, \PN beat us before.
ja: タラ: そうそう、\PNには前にやられたし。

key: I'm still mad about that!
en: I'm still mad about that!
ja: あれ、まだ根に持ってるんだから!

key: CAIN: To be fair, didn't you kinda start it?
en: CAIN: To be fair, didn't you kinda start it?
ja: カイン: 公平に言って、先に仕掛けたのそっちじゃなかったか?

key: Waitwaitwait, Charlotte--
en: Waitwaitwait, Charlotte--
ja: ちょっと待て待て待て、シャルロット――

key: What do you mean "friends"?
en: What do you mean "friends"?
ja: 「友達」ってどういうことだよ?

key: With Team Meteor?
en: With Team Meteor?
ja: チームメテオと?

key: CHARLOTTE: They're people too.
en: CHARLOTTE: They're people too.
ja: シャルロット: あいつらだって、人間だよ。

key: They just happen to be on a different side than you.
en: They just happen to be on a different side than you.
ja: たまたま、あんたと違う側にいるってだけ。

key: CAIN: And you!
en: CAIN: And you!
ja: カイン: それにお前も!

key: CHARLOTTE: Details.
en: CHARLOTTE: Details.
ja: シャルロット: 細かいことは置いといて。

key: It beats being tied up, anyhow.
en: It beats being tied up, anyhow.
ja: どのみち、縛られてるよりマシでしょ。

key: SIMON: It's not like we can just let you go because of a casual conversation.
en: SIMON: It's not like we can just let you go because of a casual conversation.
ja: サイモン: 世間話をしたからって、そのまま見逃すわけにはいかない。

key: CHARLOTTE: ...Right.
en: CHARLOTTE: ...Right.
ja: シャルロット: ……そう。

key: Well, the hard way it is then.
en: Well, the hard way it is then.
ja: じゃあ、力ずくでいくしかないね。

key: Well then, do you guys wanna do the honors?
en: Well then, do you guys wanna do the honors?
ja: それじゃ、あんたたちにお願いしようかな?

key: CAIN: The hard way is my specialty~
en: CAIN: The hard way is my specialty~
ja: カイン: 力ずくはオレの得意技だぜ~

key: I knew she would invite trouble...
en: I knew she would invite trouble...
ja: やっぱり、こいつは面倒事を招くと思ってた……

key: Would you stop that?!
en: Would you stop that?!
ja: それやめてくれない?!

key: TARA: Charlotte, tell your friends to stop being strong!
en: TARA: Charlotte, tell your friends to stop being strong!
ja: タラ: シャルロット、お友達に強すぎるのやめてって言って!

key: CHARLOTTE: Why don't you just stop being bad?
en: CHARLOTTE: Why don't you just stop being bad?
ja: シャルロット: あんたたちが悪者やめたら?

key: CAIN: Yeah, haha.
en: CAIN: Yeah, haha.
ja: カイン: そうそう、はは。

key: Quit Team Meteor, join the good guys!
en: Quit Team Meteor, join the good guys!
ja: チームメテオやめて、こっち側に来いよ!

key: SIMON: I cannot.
en: SIMON: I cannot.
ja: サイモン: それはできない。

key: CHARLOTTE: Why?
en: CHARLOTTE: Why?
ja: シャルロット: なんで?

key: SIMON: When our work is done, we will have a new life.
en: SIMON: When our work is done, we will have a new life.
ja: サイモン: 俺たちの仕事が終われば、新しい命が手に入る。

key: Not just for our sake, but for the sake of everyone...
en: Not just for our sake, but for the sake of everyone...
ja: 俺たちのためだけじゃない、みんなのためにも……

key: TARA: Team Meteor is going to rebuild the world!
en: TARA: Team Meteor is going to rebuild the world!
ja: タラ: チームメテオは世界を作り直すの!

key: By helping make it happen, we earn a place at the top later!
en: By helping make it happen, we earn a place at the top later!
ja: それを手伝った者には、後で一番上の座が約束されてる!

key: CAIN: And... this world?
en: CAIN: And... this world?
ja: カイン: それで……この世界は?

key: SIMON: Erased.
en: SIMON: Erased.
ja: サイモン: 消える。

key: Vanished.
en: Vanished.
ja: 消滅する。

key: Gone.
en: Gone.
ja: なくなる。

key: But we will live on.
en: But we will live on.
ja: でも、俺たちは生き残る。

key: The world is not what matters; its people do.
en: The world is not what matters; its people do.
ja: 大事なのは世界じゃない、そこにいる人間だ。

key: CHARLOTTE: End justifies the means.
en: CHARLOTTE: End justifies the means.
ja: シャルロット: 目的は手段を正当化する、ってわけね。

key: TARA: Exactly!
en: TARA: Exactly!
ja: タラ: そう、それ!

key: CHARLOTTE: Well, that's cool, I guess.
en: CHARLOTTE: Well, that's cool, I guess.
ja: シャルロット: まあ、それはそれでいいんじゃない。

key: Anyway, I'm going.
en: Anyway, I'm going.
ja: とにかく、あたしは行くよ。

key: Bye.
en: Bye.
ja: じゃあね。

key: And it's not like you can stop me, so don't even try.
en: And it's not like you can stop me, so don't even try.
ja: あんたたちに止められるわけないから、無駄なことはしないでよね。

key: CHARLOTTE: Hold on, Shelly was on the floor below.
en: CHARLOTTE: Hold on, Shelly was on the floor below.
ja: シャルロット: 待って、シェリーは下の階にいたよね。

key: Didn't you rescue her?
en: Didn't you rescue her?
ja: 助け出さなかったの?

key: CAIN: We couldn't even get close to her, otherwise...
en: CAIN: We couldn't even get close to her, otherwise...
ja: カイン: そうしないと、あいつに近づくことすらできなくて……

key: CHARLOTTE: ...Uh huh.
en: CHARLOTTE: ...Uh huh.
ja: シャルロット: ……ふうん。

key: GRUNT: Don't come any closer, or we'll cut her throat!
en: GRUNT: Don't come any closer, or we'll cut her throat!
ja: メテオ団員: それ以上近づくな、じゃないとこいつの喉をかっ切るぞ!

key: CHARLOTTE: ...
en: CHARLOTTE: ...
ja: シャルロット: ……

key: SHELLY: Charlotte...?
en: SHELLY: Charlotte...?
ja: シェリー: シャルロット……?

key: CHARLOTTE: Do it, then.
en: CHARLOTTE: Do it, then.
ja: シャルロット: じゃあ、やりなよ。

key: CAIN: What?
en: CAIN: What?
ja: カイン: は?

key: CHARLOTTE: Kill her.
en: CHARLOTTE: Kill her.
ja: シャルロット: 殺せば。

key: See if I care.
en: See if I care.
ja: あたしが気にするとでも思った?

key: SHELLY: Ch-Charlotte!
en: SHELLY: Ch-Charlotte!
ja: シェリー: シャ、シャルロット!

key: CHARLOTTE: She's not my family or anything.
en: CHARLOTTE: She's not my family or anything.
ja: シャルロット: 家族でも何でもないし。

key: I'm just flipping this switch to get upstairs.
en: I'm just flipping this switch to get upstairs.
ja: あたしはただ、上に行くためにこのスイッチを入れるだけ。

key: GRUNT: ...We really will!
en: GRUNT: ...We really will!
ja: メテオ団員: ……本当にやるぞ!

key: CHARLOTTE: What you do to her doesn't affect me at all, so do whatever you want.
en: CHARLOTTE: What you do to her doesn't affect me at all, so do whatever you want.
ja: シャルロット: あんたたちがその子に何しようと、あたしには関係ないから、好きにすれば。

key: CAIN: H-hey, be careful...
en: CAIN: H-hey, be careful...
ja: カイン: お、おい、気をつけろよ……

key: SHELLY: A-ah!
en: SHELLY: A-ah!
ja: シェリー: あ、ああ!

key: CHARLOTTE: \PN, now!
en: CHARLOTTE: \PN, now!
ja: シャルロット: \PN、今よ!

key: Um...
en: Um...
ja: あの……

key: Did that really just happen...?
en: Did that really just happen...?
ja: 今の、本当にあったこと……?

key: SHELLY: Ch-Charlotte, I th-thought you really d-did want me d-dead...
en: SHELLY: Ch-Charlotte, I th-thought you really d-did want me d-dead...
ja: シェリー: シャ、シャルロット、ほ、本当にあ、あたしに死んでほしいのかと……

key: CHARLOTTE: Of course not.
en: CHARLOTTE: Of course not.
ja: シャルロット: まさか、そんなわけないでしょ。

key: You helped me escape from the Orphanage.
en: You helped me escape from the Orphanage.
ja: あんたは孤児院からあたしが逃げるのを手伝ってくれた。

key: You have my respect for that.
en: You have my respect for that.
ja: それについては、敬意を払ってる。

key: But you can make someone lose control by making them believe they already don't have any.
en: But you can make someone lose control by making them believe they already don't have any.
ja: でも、「もう自分にはどうしようもない」って思わせれば、相手を制御不能にできるものなの。

key: I don't want you hurt, Shelly.
en: I don't want you hurt, Shelly.
ja: あんたに怪我してほしくなかったの、シェリー。

key: Now let's go.
en: Now let's go.
ja: さ、行こう。

key: Heather and the twins are further up.
en: Heather and the twins are further up.
ja: ヘザーと双子は、もっと上にいる。

key: So, that girl with the Lapras is gone, right?
en: So, that girl with the Lapras is gone, right?
ja: それで、あのラプラスの子は消えたってこと?

key: We still lost? C'mon.
en: We still lost? C'mon.
ja: それでも負けたの? まったく。

key: When are you gonna stop getting in our way?
en: When are you gonna stop getting in our way?
ja: あんた、いつになったら邪魔するのやめてくれるわけ?

key: Seems like now's our chance!
en: Seems like now's our chance!
ja: 今がチャンスみたいだね!

key: Ugh, even with that girl gone...
en: Ugh, even with that girl gone...
ja: くそ、あの子が消えたっていうのに……

key: I hope I never see her again. Or you.
en: I hope I never see her again. Or you.
ja: あの子にはもう二度と会いたくない。あんたにもな。

key: Surprised to see us here?
en: Surprised to see us here?
ja: ここでオレたちに会うとは思わなかったか?

key: Do whatever you want. It won't make a difference!
en: Do whatever you want. It won't make a difference!
ja: 好きにしろ。どうせ意味はない!

key: We've had Yureyu under our thumb for quite some time anyway.
en: We've had Yureyu under our thumb for quite some time anyway.
ja: どのみち、ユーレユはもうずいぶん前からオレたちの手中にある。

key: It's just ADORABLE how everyone actually thinks earthquakes destroyed Yureyu.
en: It's just ADORABLE how everyone actually thinks earthquakes destroyed Yureyu.
ja: みんな、本当に地震がユーレユを壊したと思ってるなんて、笑えるほど可愛いよな。

key: Yes, earthquakes did it! Not us, nooo!
en: Yes, earthquakes did it! Not us, nooo!
ja: そうそう、地震のせいなの! あたしたちじゃないんだからぁ!

key: You guys are sooo cute when you're misguided.
en: You guys are sooo cute when you're misguided.
ja: あんたたちって、勘違いしてる時、本当にかわいいよね。

key: SHELLY: They've got the others in cages!
en: SHELLY: They've got the others in cages!
ja: シェリー: みんな、おりに入れられてる!

key: That's so mean!
en: That's so mean!
ja: ひどい!

key: Even I just had guards!
en: Even I just had guards!
ja: あたしなんて、見張りがついてただけなのに!

key: How can they think treating anyone like this is okay!?
en: How can they think treating anyone like this is okay!?
ja: こんな扱い、どうして平気だと思えるの!?

key: Even criminals don't deserve this...
en: Even criminals don't deserve this...
ja: 犯罪者にだって、こんな扱いは酷すぎるのに……

key: CHARLOTTE: So you're keeping them locked up like we're in a zoo.
en: CHARLOTTE: So you're keeping them locked up like we're in a zoo.
ja: シャルロット: あたしたちを動物園みたいに閉じ込めてるってわけ。

key: Classy.
en: Classy.
ja: 上品なことで。

key: What kind of corporate building has cells like these in it anyway?
en: What kind of corporate building has cells like these in it anyway?
ja: そもそも、こんな独房がある企業のビルって何なわけ?

key: METEOR: This hasn't been a corporate building for a long time.
en: METEOR: This hasn't been a corporate building for a long time.
ja: メテオ団員: ここが企業のビルだったのは、もうずいぶん昔の話だ。

key: Surely you've heard how years ago, Yureyu was the centerpiece of Reborn's economy.
en: Surely you've heard how years ago, Yureyu was the centerpiece of Reborn's economy.
ja: 何年も前、ユーレユがリボーンの経済の中心だったって話くらい、聞いたことあるだろう。

key: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, yeah, the economy was booming and then it was stricken by earthquakes, and then it was over.
en: CHARLOTTE: Yeah, yeah, the economy was booming and then it was stricken by earthquakes, and then it was over.
ja: シャルロット: はいはい、経済は絶好調で、それが地震にやられて、それで終わり、でしょ。

key: METEOR: Wrong!
en: METEOR: Wrong!
ja: メテオ団員: 違う!

key: Earthquakes didn't destroy Yureyu--
en: Earthquakes didn't destroy Yureyu--
ja: 地震がユーレユを壊したんじゃない――

key: Team Meteor did!
en: Team Meteor did!
ja: チームメテオがやったんだ!

key: We infiltrated the company over time and shut them down from the inside out!
en: We infiltrated the company over time and shut them down from the inside out!
ja: 時間をかけて会社に潜り込み、内側から潰してやったのさ!

key: NOEL: And it was the closure of Yureyu's Power Plant that led to the city's downfall.
en: NOEL: And it was the closure of Yureyu's Power Plant that led to the city's downfall.
ja: ノエル: そして、ユーレユの発電所の閉鎖が、街の衰退につながった。

key: So then Team Meteor was successful in destroying Reborn City the first time.
en: So then Team Meteor was successful in destroying Reborn City the first time.
ja: つまり、チームメテオは一度、リボーンシティの破壊に成功していたわけだ。

key: METEOR: Bingo, kiddo.
en: METEOR: Bingo, kiddo.
ja: メテオ団員: 正解だ、坊主。

key: We were set to do it again by destroying Julia's Gym-- the new power plant!
en: We were set to do it again by destroying Julia's Gym-- the new power plant!
ja: 今度はジュリアのジム――新しい発電所を破壊して、もう一度やるつもりだった!

key: But SOMEONE got in the way.
en: But SOMEONE got in the way.
ja: だが、誰かさんが邪魔をしてくれてな。

key: And here you are again.
en: And here you are again.
ja: そしてまた、お前が現れたわけだ。

key: Sounds like a nice time for revenge, yeah?
en: Sounds like a nice time for revenge, yeah?
ja: ふくしゅうにはちょうどいい時じゃないか、な?

key: One day, you'll see...
en: One day, you'll see...
ja: いつか、わかる時が来るさ……

key: Even if you beat us, you won't stop us.
en: Even if you beat us, you won't stop us.
ja: 俺たちを倒したところで、止められはしないぞ。

key: METEOR: Do as you please.
en: METEOR: Do as you please.
ja: メテオ団員: 好きにしろ。
